title: How to Buy Your First Rental Property with No Money
summary: Real-estate coach pitches buying rentals with no money down via hard money, BRRRR refinancing, subject-to deals and crowdfunding, and promotes her own crowdfund webinar.

assertions.quote: When we say no money, we're talking about your money, you don't have to put any money into it.
They can lend you all of that money, alright?
you refinance out of that mortgage once the house is fixed up.
each month while the tenant is paying the rent, they were paying down my mortgage.
you have to find people with property problems. It's the best way to do it.
you can buy the property and leave that existing financing in place and then you take over those mortgage payments

verdicts.note: Subject-to deals are legal and do happen, but the lender can call the loan under the due-on-sale clause and motivated sellers with assumable equity are scarce.

assertions.quote: know that even more importantly you want to be able to sell those bad boys and start getting 6-figure checks.

verdicts.note: Sale profits depend mostly on local appreciation and selling costs; in flat or falling markets, like the 2009 crash she describes, there is no lump sum.

assertions.quote: if you get your own crowd fund, you don't have to spend any money.

verdicts.note: Raising a fund means securities-law filings, offering costs and a track record investors trust; first-timers rarely raise money this way.

assertions.quote: You have to leverage other people's money.
when 2009 happened in the crash happened, I lost everything.
